title: PlayAh! — Brand Growth & Performance
summary: Brand campaigns, multi-channel paid media, and community-driven growth for PlayAh!, a leading Vietnamese entertainment platform.
description:
Planned and executed full-funnel digital campaigns across Meta, TikTok, and Google Ads. Built a data-driven content calendar, optimized for ROAS, and scaled paid acquisition while maintaining brand voice.

Key outcomes include a 3× uplift in monthly active users across social channels and a 40% reduction in cost-per-lead through creative iteration and audience segmentation.

The work spanned brand strategy, performance media buying, influencer partnerships, and weekly analytics reporting to the leadership team.
